clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Fishing guides outdoorsmen in the essential crafts and etiquette of wilderness survival. It teaches adventurers how to create a decorative Fish Bowl for their campsite and emphasizes the necessity of learning campfire craft from a cooking trainer before heading into the wild.

Life on the road across Azeroth demands practical knowledge of the frontier. For aspiring anglers and wanderers, setting up an orderly site requires understanding basic outdoor etiquette. Townsfolk and guards frown upon travelers pitching tents and scattering gear in the center of settlements, so anyone wishing to rest must take their supplies out beyond city borders and into the open wilderness.

A proper expedition site requires several essential amenities. Above all, no campsite is considered functional without a warm campfire, a skill traditionally imparted by culinary instructors. Once a fire is sparked, seasoned travelers can lay out specialty accoutrements such as a handcrafted Fish Bowl, transforming a simple rest stop into a fully outfitted angler's haven.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
